text: げんきな　ポケモンは　にげやすいし　うんも　あるからな！

structure.jp: げんきな　ポケモンは　にげやすいし
structure.en: a healthy Pokémon escapes easily, and

structure.jp: うんも　あるからな！

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement means 'and what's more', used when listing reasons. にげやすいし = 'it escapes easily, and besides'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい stuck onto a verb stem says the action happens easily. にげやすい = 'escapes easily'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a verb means 'because'. Here the sentence ends on it, giving the reason for the line before; な adds 'you know'. うんもあるからな = 'because luck comes into it too, you know'.
